# NZ Document Assist

> NZ Document Assist is an independent New Zealand administrative document-assistance, coordination and logistics service. We help people prepare New Zealand documents for overseas use by coordinating apostille and authentication processing, notary public appointments, translation, and courier/document return — with clear, upfront pricing and one point of contact for the whole process. We are based in Auckland and assist clients throughout New Zealand by phone, email and courier, with in-person help available in Auckland.

We are not a government agency, law firm, Notary Public, Justice of the Peace service, or licensed immigration adviser. We coordinate administrative steps on a client's behalf; government, notary, translation and courier fees are charged separately from our coordination fee.

## Core services

- [Apostille NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-nz/): Coordination of the apostille process for eligible New Zealand documents being prepared for overseas use. Coordination fee from NZ$79 plus the NZ government apostille fee.
- [Document Authentication NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/document-authentication-nz/): Coordination for New Zealand documents that require authentication (rather than apostille) for overseas use. From NZ$99.
- [Notary Public Auckland Help](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/notary-public-auckland-help/): Help arranging an appointment with an independent New Zealand Notary Public. From NZ$39.
- [Translation Coordination NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/translation-coordination-nz/): Administrative coordination with an independent translation provider. From NZ$39.
- [Courier & Document Return](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/courier-document-return/): Coordination of dispatch, tracking, return or onward delivery of documents. From NZ$25.
- [Pricing](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/pricing/): Full, transparent price list for every service, including multi-step and complex/international case packages.
- [How It Works](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/how-it-works/): The three-step process — tell us what you need, get a transparent quote, we coordinate the agreed administrative stages.
- [About](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/about/): Who we are and the scope of the service.
- [Contact](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/contact/): Get a free initial document assessment. Phone: 022 100 3242.

## Guides and resources

- [Documents for Overseas Use](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/documents-for-overseas-use/): Overview of when a New Zealand document needs apostille, authentication or translation for use abroad.
- [Apostille vs Authentication NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-vs-authentication-nz/): How to tell which process a document needs.
- [New Zealand Apostille Requirements](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/new-zealand-apostille-requirements/): What's required to apostille a New Zealand document.
- [Who Can Certify Documents in NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/who-can-certify-documents-nz/): Who is authorised to certify copies and documents in New Zealand.
- [JP vs Notary Public NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/jp-vs-notary-public-nz/): The difference between a Justice of the Peace and a Notary Public, and which one a document needs.
- [Certified Copy of a Passport NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/certified-copy-passport-nz/): How to get a certified copy of a New Zealand passport.
- [Apostille Auckland](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-auckland/): Apostille assistance for clients in and around Auckland.
- [Apostille Birth Certificate NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-birth-certificate-nz/): Apostilling a New Zealand birth certificate for overseas use.
- [Apostille Marriage Certificate NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-marriage-certificate-nz/): Apostilling a New Zealand marriage certificate for overseas use.
- [Apostille Education Documents NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-education-documents-nz/): Apostilling New Zealand qualifications and education documents.
- [Apostille Criminal Record NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-criminal-record-nz/): Apostilling a New Zealand criminal record / police check.
- [Apostille Power of Attorney NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-power-of-attorney-nz/): Apostilling a New Zealand power of attorney document.
- [Apostille Divorce Dissolution NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-divorce-dissolution-nz/): Apostilling New Zealand divorce/dissolution papers.
- [Certificate of No Impediment NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/certificate-no-impediment-nz/): Getting and apostilling a New Zealand certificate of no impediment.
- [E-Apostille NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/e-apostille-nz/): Paper apostille vs electronic (e-apostille) — which applies and when.
- [Resources Hub](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/resources/): Full index of NZ apostille and overseas document guides.
